# Code of Conduct

Be decent.

This is a personal GitHub space for code, notes, tools, and security research-adjacent work. Discussion, suggestions, fixes, and questions are welcome.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful
- Be constructive
- Stay on topic
- Assume good intent where reasonable
- Prefer technical clarity over ego

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment
- Abuse
- Personal attacks
- Spam
- Publishing private information
- Encouraging illegal activity

## Enforcement

I may delete comments, close issues, block users, or restrict participation where needed.
